name: twitter_mcp
summary: X (Twitter) API connector — SINGLE main profile (trollz removed 2026-05-28). Auto-config via TwitterConnector.from_env() reads X_BEARER_TOKEN + X_CONSUMER_KEY + X_CONSUMER_SECRET_KEY + X_ACCESS_TOKEN + X_ACCESS_SECRET_TOKEN. Read path uses stdlib urllib + bearer auth (zero dep); write path uses tweepy when installed. Bearer probe of all 8 X-prefixed candidates 2026-05-28 confirmed: only X_BEARER_TOKEN and X_TROLLZ_BEARER are bearer-shaped, and both route to the SAME enrolled X account (2041735171829911552) which is depleted — they are duplicate bearers for one effective account.
engine_pattern: ThirdPartyConnector subclass. Stdlib urllib for read (verify_credentials, get_user, recent_tweets) returns distinct semantics for 200 (success), 401 (bad bearer), 402 (auth OK but no API credits on the plan), 403 (missing scopes). Tweepy still used for create_tweet + send_direct_message write path when installed.

env_vars.X_ACCESS_TOKEN: OAuth 1.0a user token (for writes via tweepy)
env_vars.X_ACCESS_SECRET_TOKEN: OAuth 1.0a user secret (for writes via tweepy)

usage_example:
from core.lib.third_party.twitter import TwitterConnector
c = TwitterConnector.from_env()
r = c.verify_credentials()
if r['auth_works'] and r.get('status') != 402:
    print(c.get_user('zero2onez'))
else:
    print('billing or scope issue — see r["remedy"]')
